answer_1.quote: We show that models trained on this diverse dataset yield significantly better OOD generalization performance compared to other state-of-the-art methods...
answer_1.outputs: sequence of API calls with their parameter names and values

answer_2.quote: To perform a fine-grained evaluation of the generated responses, we use two kinds of evaluation—standard information retrieval metrics (precision, recall, and F1 scores) and Longest Common Subsequence (LCS).

answer_4.quote: To check the quality of API-BLEND datasets, we perform human annotation over 50 randomly sampled data from 5 in-distribution datasets (at least 2 annotators per dataset).
answer_4.guideline: the annotators score each gold sample (1 if correct, 0 otherwise) based on the following 3 metrics: (1) 'Intent': whether the intents/APIs in the output are correct to answer the query; (2) 'Sequence(Intent)': whether the intents are in the proper sequence; and (3) 'Slot': whether the slot names and slot-values are correct.
